blocks.html: Note: Ukunduka does not treat dropped items, raw fish, Saradomin brews, or baron sharks as food and will not take these items. The fight with Ukunduka is instanced, and will not warn players if they drop items. When the fight ends, players will be sent back to the non-instanced pyramid without a chance to pick up any dropped items.
